description: neuroimaging-decoding 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：ROI 多变量解码；ROI GLM 与 FDR；SearchLight 分类。

method_refs.label: ROI 多变量解码
method_refs.role: Run the original MVPA mode on tabular features and an explicit target; cross-validate the selected classification or regression estimator and save metrics and predictions. Inputs: features: 特征 CSV (file). Registered outputs: results/metrics.json, results/predictions.csv. Fixed invocation options: --mode mvpa.

method_refs.label: ROI GLM 与 FDR
method_refs.role: Join ROI features and the design table by subject ID, fit the original ROI-wise GLM with the selected contrast column, and export ROI test results and FDR summary counts. Inputs: features: 特征 CSV (file); design: 设计矩阵 CSV (file). Registered outputs: results/roi_glm_results.csv. Fixed invocation options: --mode roi-glm.

method_refs.label: SearchLight 分类
method_refs.role: Run the original SearchLight implementation on the supplied image list, mask and row-aligned target labels with the selected number of cross-validation folds; export the score image. Inputs: images_list: 影像路径清单 (file); features: 特征 CSV (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/searchlight_scores.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --mode searchlight.

selection_rules: 表格特征预测选择 MVPA，逐 ROI 统计推断选择 ROI GLM，空间局部预测图选择 SearchLight；三类结果的科学含义不同。
name: neuroimaging-decoding
